operators.name: cummin_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides; contiguous or non-contiguous, but must be on CUDA

semantics: For each column j, output[i,j] = min(x[0,j], x[1,j], ..., x[i,j])
Output tensor has same shape, dtype, device as input
Input must be CUDA float32; output allocated as empty_like(x)
Non-contiguous input is supported: the kernel should handle strides correctly (e.g., access via linear offsets computed from strides)
Compute cumulative minimum along dimension 0 of input tensor x
Output: [10000, 128] float32 CUDA tensor with cumulative minimum values
The first value of torch.cummin returns values, the second returns indices; model takes [0] so only values are needed
